items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What was the name of the band? Tom Albert and Bones. Did they ever call him Kid Albert? Yeah, that's right. Kid Albert and Bones.

ctx.x: trombones. Excuse me sir. Clowns on banjo, they call them dad. Oh, they're clowns friends? Yeah, dad, um, banjo and myself. You were playing clowns still? Yeah. What was that at? Oh, we played, oh, a lot of different places. We were in Texas, stayed out there three weeks from Texas.
What was the name of the band? Tom Albert and Bones. Did they ever call him Kid Albert? Yeah, that's right. Kid Albert and Bones.
Did you know any of the musicians personally from New Orleans before you went there? You know, I mean, they're really friendly with them. What did you sort of?
